name: Extreme heat
summary: Bureau of Meteorology warns of severe to extreme heatwave in Queensland's Peninsula through the weekend of 14–15 Nov
state: The Bureau of Meteorology's Queensland heatwave warning issued on 12 Nov forecast severe to extreme heatwave conditions continuing in the Peninsula through the weekend, easing in the Gulf Country, with maximums in the high 30s to low 40s°C (WillyWeather, citing BoM). Earlier in the month extreme warnings covered the Kimberley and Tiwi Islands, and Fitzroy Crossing reached 45.1°C on 3 Nov (IQAir). Regional warnings meet the Watch line; no deadly heatwave under top-tier warnings across a large population was found as of 12 Nov.
for_you: Remote communities in far north Queensland, outdoor workers and older people are most exposed. Anyone in or travelling to northern Australia should follow Bureau of Meteorology warnings and Queensland Health heat advice.
rubric_hit: Watch: heatwave warnings across a major region (BoM severe–extreme heatwave warning, Queensland Peninsula, 12 Nov)

rubric.alert: Deadly heatwave with top-tier official warnings across a large population.
